## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] `npx svelte-check` adds no new errors
- [ ] Playwright suite added or updated for the feature (`npm run e2e -- <name>`), or n/a
- [ ] Anything replicated follows the golden rules in `CLAUDE.md` — applied locally *and*
      sent to peers, a `get<domain>` reply for late joiners, cleanup on disconnect
- [ ] Docs updated if this changes user-facing behaviour or the module SDK
